name: savannah-hms
description: Drug store management app: point of sale, inventory, expiry tracking, reports.

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
